description: List the email conversations in one website's Email inbox, newest first: subject, sender, a snippet and whether a person must answer. Needs the Pro plan or higher. Use get_email_thread to read one.

limit.description: How many conversations to return (1-100, default 25).

show.description: all: every email that arrived (default). customers: the conversations the AI handles. needs_person: only what waits for the team.

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.

name: list_emails
title: List support emails
